name.en: the old ways of the peoples

origin.ja: 秦の名将王翦の孫で、王賁の子。三代にわたって秦の将を務めた家。
origin.en: Grandson of Qin's great general Wang Jian and son of Wang Ben — the third generation of a family of Qin generals.

origin.ja: 陽夏の人。辺境の守りに送られる途中、大沢郷で雨に足止めされ、[[p:陳勝]]とともに反乱を起こした。
origin.en: A man of Yangxia. Held up by rain at Dazexiang on the way to frontier service, he rose in revolt with [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]].

origin.ja: 大梁の人。若いころ[[p:張耳]]と首をはねられても悔いない交わり (刎頸の交わり) を結んだが、のちに仇どうしとなった。
origin.en: A man of Daliang. In youth he and [[p:張耳|Zhang Er]] swore a friendship "for which they would lose their heads", but they ended as enemies.

origin.ja: 斉の王族田氏の一門。兄の[[p:田栄]]とともに斉を立て直した。のちに島へ逃れた田横に従った五百人の食客は、田横の死を聞いてみな自ら命を絶った。
origin.en: Of the royal Tian of Qi; with his brother [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] he rebuilt Qi. When he died, the five hundred retainers who had fled with him to an island all took their own lives.

origin.ja: 楚の令尹 (宰相) だった人。[[p:項梁]]の敗れることを言い当てて名を上げ、懐王に上将軍とされた。
origin.en: Once chief minister of Chu. He foretold [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]]'s defeat, made his name by it, and was made supreme general by King Huai.

origin.ja: 伊廬の人。[[p:韓信]]とは古くからの友だった。
origin.en: A man of Yilu, an old friend of [[p:韓信|Han Xin]].

origin.ja: 楚の人。任侠で知られ、「黄金百斤を得るは、季布の一諾を得るに如かず」と言われた。
origin.en: A man of Chu, famous for keeping his word: "Better one promise from Ji Bu than a hundred catties of gold."

origin.ja: 沛の人。秦の沛県で獄の役人を務め、[[p:蕭何]]とともに[[p:劉邦]]を支えた。
origin.en: A man of Pei. A prison officer of Qin's Pei county, he backed [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] with [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]].

origin.ja: 沛の人。犬を屠ってその肉を売って暮らしていた。[[p:劉邦]]の妻呂雉の妹を妻とした。
origin.en: A man of Pei who lived by butchering dogs. He married the sister of [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]]'s wife Lü Zhi.

origin.ja: 沛の人。沛の厩で車馬を扱う役人で、通るたびに[[p:劉邦]]と語り合う仲だった。
origin.en: A man of Pei, a stableman of the county, who would stop and talk with [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] whenever he passed.

origin.ja: 沛の人。蚕を飼う道具を編んで暮らし、葬式で簫を吹く仕事もしていた。
origin.en: A man of Pei who made a living weaving trays for silkworms and playing the pipes at funerals.

origin.ja: 豊の人。[[p:劉邦]]と同じ日に生まれ、父どうしも親しかった幼なじみ。
origin.en: A man of Feng, born on the same day as [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]], whose father was his father's friend: a friend from the cradle.

origin.ja: 淮陰の人。貧しく、川で綿を晒す老婆に食を恵まれ、町の若者の股をくぐらされる辱めも受けた。[[p:項梁]]・[[p:項羽]]に仕えたが用いられず、[[p:劉邦]]のもとへ走った。
origin.en: A man of Huaiyin. So poor that an old woman washing silk by the river fed him, he was made to crawl between a bully's legs. He served [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] and [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] unheeded, then went over to [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]].

origin.ja: 昌邑の人。鉅野の沢で漁をしながら群盗の頭となった。
origin.en: A man of Changyi who fished the Juye marshes and led a band of outlaws.

origin.ja: 沛の人。[[p:劉邦]]がまだ若いころ、兄のように仕えた沛の豪族。
origin.en: A man of Pei, a local magnate whom the young [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] treated as an elder brother.

origin.ja: 睢陽の人。絹を売る商人だった。
origin.en: A man of Suiyang who had been a silk seller.

events.ja: 匈奴の太子冒頓は、自分の[[a:mingdi|鳴鏑]]の射る先へ必ず射よと部下を鍛え、ついに父の[[p:頭曼単于]]を射させて単于となった。
events.en: Modu, heir of the Xiongnu, trained his men to shoot wherever his [[a:mingdi|whistling arrow]] flew — and at last had them shoot his father, [[p:頭曼単于|Touman Chanyu]]. He became chanyu himself.

events.ja: {r_qin}は[[p:趙高]]の言に従って兄弟の公子十二人を咸陽の市で殺し、公主十人を杜で車裂きにした。群臣は罪を恐れ、諫める者はいなくなった。
events.en: On [[p:趙高|Zhao Gao]]'s advice {r_qin} had twelve of his brothers put to death in the market of Xianyang and ten of his sisters torn apart by chariots at Du. The ministers feared for themselves, and no one spoke up any more.

events.ja: 大沢郷の乱。北の守りへ送られる途中、大雨で期日に遅れて死罪が決まった[[p:陳勝]]・[[p:呉広]]は「王侯将相いずくんぞ種あらんや」と叫んで兵を挙げ、陳で王を称して国を張楚と号した。
events.en: The rising at Dazexiang. On their way to the northern frontier, held up by rain and so condemned to death for being late, [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]] and [[p:呉広|Wu Guang]] cried "Are kings and generals born to it?" and rose. Chen Sheng made himself king at Chen and called his realm Zhang Chu.

events.ja: [[p:陳勝]]の部将[[p:武臣]]は北の趙の地を平らげ、邯鄲で自ら趙王を称した。
events.en: [[p:武臣|Wu Chen]], a captain of [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]], took the old land of Zhao in the north and made himself King of Zhao at Handan.

events.ja: 沛の亭長だった[[p:劉邦]]は、県令を殺した沛の人々に推されて立ち、「沛公」と呼ばれた。
events.en: [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]], once a village constable of Pei, was put forward by the townsmen after they killed their magistrate, and was called the Lord of Pei.

events.ja: 楚の名将項燕の子[[p:項梁]]は、甥の[[p:項羽]]とともに会稽の郡守を斬って兵を挙げた。二十四歳の項羽は、その日だけで数十人を斬ったという。
events.en: [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]], son of the great Chu general Xiang Yan, rose with his nephew [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] by cutting down the governor of Kuaiji; Xiang Yu, twenty-four, is said to have killed scores that day alone.

events.ja: 燕では[[p:韓広]]が燕王を称し、斉では旧王族の[[p:田儋]]が県令を殺して斉王を称した。
events.en: In Yan, [[p:韓広|Han Guang]] declared himself King of Yan; in Qi, [[p:田儋|Tian Dan]] of the old royal house killed the magistrate and declared himself King of Qi.

events.ja: {n_zhangchu}の将の周文は数十万を率いて函谷関を破り、咸陽に近い戯まで迫った。少府の[[p:章邯]]は驪山の陵で働く囚人や奴隷を赦して兵とし、周文を打ち破った。
events.en: Zhou Wen, a general of {n_zhangchu}, broke through the Hangu pass with hundreds of thousands and came as far as Xi, close to Xianyang. The treasurer [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] freed the convicts and slaves at work on the Lishan tomb, made them an army and routed him.

events.ja: 魏の旧王族[[p:魏咎]]が魏王に立てられた。
events.en: [[p:魏咎|Wei Jiu]] of the old royal house of Wei was set up as King of Wei.

events.ja: 秦将[[p:章邯]]に敗れて逃げる[[p:陳勝]]は、御者の荘賈に殺された。蜂起からわずか半年であった。反乱の旗は楚の[[p:項梁]]へ移った。
events.en: Beaten by the Qin general [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]], [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]] was killed in flight by his own charioteer, barely half a year after the rising. The banner of revolt passed to [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] of Chu.

events.ja: 滎陽を囲んでいた[[p:呉広]]は、部将の田臧に「兵法を知らない」とされて殺された。田臧は[[p:陳勝]]に許しを得たが、まもなく[[p:章邯]]に敗れて死んだ。
events.en: [[p:呉広|Wu Guang]], besieging Xingyang, was killed by his officer Tian Zang, who said he knew nothing of war. [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]] accepted it, but Tian Zang was soon beaten and killed by [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]].

events.ja: 趙の将の李良が背いて邯鄲を襲い、{r_zhao}を殺した。逃れた[[p:張耳]]と[[p:陳余]]は兵を集め、趙の王族の[[p:趙歇]]を王に立てて信都 (襄国) に拠った。
events.en: Li Liang, a general of Zhao, turned on Handan and killed {r_zhao}. [[p:張耳|Zhang Er]] and [[p:陳余|Chen Yu]] escaped, gathered troops, and set up [[p:趙歇|Zhao Xie]] of the old royal house as king at Xindu (Xiangguo).

events.ja: {r_chu}は江東の子弟八千を率いて長江を渡り、陳嬰や[[p:英布]]らを加えて淮水を越え、下邳に入った。彭城の東では、[[p:陳勝]]の死後に景駒を王に立てていた秦嘉を破った。
events.en: {r_chu} crossed the Yangzi with eight thousand young men of Jiangdong, gathered Chen Ying, [[p:英布|Ying Bu]] and others, crossed the Huai and entered Xiapi. East of Pengcheng he beat Qin Jia, who had made Jing Ju king after [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]]'s death.

events.ja: [[p:張良]]の勧めで韓の旧王族[[p:韓成]]が韓王に立てられた。
events.en: At [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]]'s urging, [[p:韓成|Han Cheng]] of the old royal house of Hann was set up as its king.

events.ja: [[p:項梁]]は[[p:范増]]の献策を容れ、羊飼いをしていた楚の王族の孫心を探し出して楚の懐王に立てた。
events.en: On [[p:范増|Fan Zeng]]'s advice [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] sought out Xin, a grandson of the old Chu kings who was herding sheep, and made him King Huai of Chu.

events.ja: [[p:章邯]]は臨済を囲み、救援に来た斉王[[p:田儋]]を討った。[[p:魏咎]]は民の命と引き換えに降り、自ら火に入って死んだ。
events.en: [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] besieged Linji and killed [[p:田儋|Tian Dan]] of Qi, who had come to its aid; [[p:魏咎|Wei Jiu]] surrendered to save his people and threw himself into a fire.

events.ja: [[p:趙高]]に謀反の罪を着せられた丞相の[[p:李斯]]は、咸陽の市で腰斬にされた。刑場へ引かれる途中、李斯は息子に「お前とまた黄色い犬を連れて上蔡の東門を出て、兎を追いたかったが、もうかなわぬ」と言って泣いた。
events.en: Falsely charged with treason by [[p:趙高|Zhao Gao]], the chancellor [[p:李斯|Li Si]] was cut in two in the market of Xianyang. On the way he said to his son, weeping: "I wanted to go out once more with you and the brown dog by the east gate of Shangcai, hunting hares. It cannot be now."

events.ja: 連勝に驕った[[p:項梁]]は、定陶で[[p:章邯]]の夜襲を受けて戦死した。
events.en: Grown proud with victory, [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] was caught by a night attack of [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] at Dingtao and killed.

events.ja: [[p:項梁]]の死を聞いた楚の懐王は盱眙から彭城に移り、[[p:項羽]]と呂臣の軍を自ら率いた。[[p:宋義]]を上将軍とし、項羽をその次将とした。
events.en: Hearing of [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]]'s death, King Huai of Chu moved from Xuyi to Pengcheng and took the armies of [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] and Lü Chen under his own command. He made [[p:宋義|Song Yi]] supreme general, with Xiang Yu second under him.

events.ja: {n_qin}の[[p:章邯]]は邯鄲を落とし、城壁を壊して民を河内に移した。{r_zhao}と[[p:張耳]]は鉅鹿城に逃げ込み、秦の[[p:王離]]に囲まれた。
events.en: [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] of {n_qin} took Handan, pulled down its walls and moved its people to Henei. {r_zhao} and [[p:張耳|Zhang Er]] fled into Julu and were besieged there by [[p:王離|Wang Li]] of Qin.

events.ja: 鉅鹿の戦い。[[p:項羽]]は渡河すると船を沈め、釜を壊し、三日分の食糧だけを持たせて退路を断ち ([[a:pofu|破釜沈舟]])、[[p:王離]]の秦軍を九度戦って破った。諸侯の将は膝で進んで項羽の陣に入り、顔を上げられなかったという。
events.en: The battle of Julu. Once across the river [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] [[a:pofu|sank the boats and broke the cooking pots]], leaving three days' food and no way back; he fought [[p:王離|Wang Li]]'s Qin army nine times and broke it. The other lords' generals came into his camp on their knees, it is said, and dared not look up.

events.ja: 鉅鹿の救援に向かいながら安陽に四十六日もとどまって進まなかった上将軍の[[p:宋義]]を、[[p:項羽]]は朝の挨拶に入った帳の中で斬った。懐王はこれを追認し、項羽を上将軍とした。
events.en: Sent to relieve Julu, the supreme general [[p:宋義|Song Yi]] sat forty-six days at Anyang without moving. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] went into his tent at the morning audience and cut off his head; King Huai accepted it and made Xiang Yu supreme general.

events.ja: [[p:趙高]]に疑われて行き場を失った[[p:章邯]]は、二十万の兵とともに[[p:項羽]]に降った。降った秦兵は新安で夜のうちに穴埋めにされたと伝わる。
events.en: Distrusted by [[p:趙高|Zhao Gao]] and with nowhere to turn, [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] surrendered to [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] with two hundred thousand men; the surrendered Qin soldiers were buried alive at Xin'an in a single night, the records say.

events.ja: 西へ進む{r_liu}は南陽の宛を囲んだ。陳恢の勧めで{r_liu}は宛の太守を許して侯に封じ、その兵を連れて西へ進んだ。行く先々の城は戦わずに下った。
events.en: Marching west, {r_liu} besieged Wan in Nanyang. On Chen Hui's advice he spared the governor, made him a marquis and took his troops along; the towns ahead surrendered without a fight.

events.ja: [[p:趙高]]は[[p:二世皇帝]]に鹿を献じて「馬です」と言い、鹿と答えた臣を陥れた ([[a:zhilu|指鹿為馬]])。やがて趙高は望夷宮で二世皇帝を自害させ、[[p:子嬰]]を立てた。子嬰は帝号を捨てて秦王と称し、趙高を誅した。
events.en: [[p:趙高|Zhao Gao]] presented a deer to [[p:二世皇帝|the Second Emperor]] and [[a:zhilu|called it a horse]], and ruined those who said "deer". Soon he forced the emperor to kill himself in the Wangyi palace and set up [[p:子嬰|Ziying]], who gave up the imperial title for "King of Qin" — and had Zhao Gao put to death.

events.ja: 武関から関中に入った{r_liu}に、秦王[[p:子嬰]]は首に紐をかけ、白馬の車で迎えて降った。[[p:劉邦]]は宝物に手をつけず、秦の苛法を廃して[[a:yuefa|「法三章」]]だけを約し、民の心をつかんだ。
events.en: {r_liu} came into the land within the passes by the Wu pass; [[p:子嬰|Ziying]], King of Qin, met him in a white-horse carriage with a cord round his neck and surrendered. [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] left the treasures alone, abolished the harsh Qin laws, and [[a:yuefa|promised just three]] — and won the people.

events.ja: 関中へ向かう途中、降った秦の兵たちが不穏だと聞いた{r_chu}は、新安の城の南で二十余万を夜のうちに穴埋めにした。のちに秦の人々は、[[p:章邯]]ら三人の降将を深く恨んだ。
events.en: On the way to Guanzhong, told that the surrendered Qin soldiers were restless, {r_chu} had more than two hundred thousand of them buried alive by night south of Xin'an. The people of Qin never forgave [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] and the two other generals who had surrendered them.

events.ja: [[a:hongmen|鴻門の会]]。関中を先に取られて怒る[[p:項羽]]のもとへ、[[p:劉邦]]は自ら謝罪に赴いた。[[p:范増]]は項荘に剣舞をさせて劉邦を討たせようとしたが、[[p:項伯]]が共に舞って庇い、[[p:樊噲]]が盾を持って乱入した。劉邦は厠に立つふりをして逃れた。范増は「豎子ともに謀るに足らず」と玉斗を砕いた。
events.en: [[a:hongmen|The feast at Hongmen]]. [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] came in person to apologise to [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]], furious that Liu had reached the passes first. [[p:范増|Fan Zeng]] had Xiang Zhuang perform a sword dance to kill him; [[p:項伯|Xiang Bo]] danced too and shielded him, and [[p:樊噲|Fan Kuai]] burst in with his shield. Liu Bang slipped away as if to the privy. "The boy is not worth plotting with," Fan Zeng said, and smashed his jade cup.

events.ja: 咸陽に入った{r_chu}は[[p:子嬰]]を殺し、[[a:afang|宮殿を焼いた]]。火は三か月消えなかったという。秦は滅んだ。
events.en: {r_chu} entered Xianyang, killed [[p:子嬰|Ziying]] and [[a:afang|burned the palaces]]; the fire burned for three months, it is said. Qin was no more.

events.ja: [[p:項羽]]は自ら西楚覇王と称して彭城を都とし、諸侯の将を十八の王に封じた。[[p:劉邦]]は約束の関中ではなく、辺地の巴・蜀・漢中の漢王とされた。関中は秦の降将[[p:章邯]]・[[p:司馬欣]]・[[p:董翳]]の三人に分けられた。
events.en: [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] took the title Hegemon-King of Western Chu with Pengcheng as his capital, and made the lords' generals kings of eighteen realms. [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] was given not the land within the passes he had been promised, but the remote Ba, Shu and Hanzhong as King of Han; the land within the passes went to three surrendered Qin generals, [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]], [[p:司馬欣|Sima Xin]] and [[p:董翳|Dong Yi]].

events.ja: 漢中へ入る[[p:劉邦]]は、[[p:張良]]の勧めで通った桟道を焼き、東へ戻る気がないことを[[p:項羽]]に示した。
events.en: On his way into Hanzhong, [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] burned the plank roads behind him at [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]]'s advice, to show [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] he had no thought of coming back east.

events.ja: 漢中で認められず逃げ出した[[p:韓信]]を、[[p:蕭何]]は夜を徹して追って連れ戻し、「天下を争うなら韓信のほかに計る者はいない」と{r_liu}に説いた。{r_liu}は壇を築き、韓信を大将に任じた。
events.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]], unrecognised in Hanzhong, ran away; [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]] rode after him all night and brought him back. "If you mean to contend for the realm, he is the only man to plan it with," he told {r_liu}, who built an altar and made Han Xin his great general.

events.ja: 王に封じられなかった斉の[[p:田栄]]は、[[p:項羽]]の立てた斉の王たちを攻め殺して斉を一つにし、項羽に背いた。
events.en: Left out of the kingdoms, [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] of Qi attacked and killed the kings [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] had set up in Qi, united it, and defied Xiang Yu.

events.ja: [[p:韓信]]の策で、{r_liu}はひそかに陳倉の道から関中へ攻め入り (暗渡陳倉)、塞王・翟王を降して関中の大半を取り戻した。[[p:章邯]]は廃丘に籠もった。
events.en: On [[p:韓信|Han Xin]]'s plan {r_liu} slipped into the land within the passes by the Chencang road, brought down the kings of Sai and Di, and won back most of it; [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] shut himself up in Feiqiu.

events.ja: 河南王[[p:申陽]]が漢に降った。
events.en: [[p:申陽|Shen Yang]], King of Henan, surrendered to Han.

events.ja: {r_chu}は懐王を義帝と尊んで長沙の郴に移らせ、その途中、[[p:英布]]らに命じて江の中で殺させた。
events.en: {r_chu}, who had honoured King Huai as the Righteous Emperor, sent him away to Chen in Changsha, and on the way had [[p:英布|Ying Bu]] and others kill him on the river.

events.ja: 漢は韓王[[p:鄭昌]]を降し、韓の公子信を韓王とした。
events.en: Han brought down [[p:鄭昌|Zheng Chang]], King of Hann, and made Prince Xin of Hann its king.

events.ja: [[p:陳余]]は斉の兵を借りて常山王[[p:張耳]]を追い、張耳は漢へ逃れた。かつて刎頸の交わりを結んだ二人は敵となった。
events.en: [[p:陳余|Chen Yu]], with troops borrowed from Qi, drove out [[p:張耳|Zhang Er]], King of Changshan, who fled to Han. The two who had once sworn friendship to the death were now enemies.

events.ja: 城陽の戦い。{r_chu}は城陽で{r_qi}を破った。平原に逃げた[[p:田栄]]は民に殺された。[[p:項羽]]は斉の城郭を焼き、降った兵を穴埋めにしたので、斉の人々はかえって集まって背き、田栄の弟の[[p:田横]]が田栄の子の[[p:田広]]を立てた。
events.en: The battle of Chengyang. {r_chu} beat {r_qi} at Chengyang; [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] fled to Pingyuan and was killed by its people. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] burned the walls of Qi and buried the surrendered soldiers alive, so the people of Qi only gathered and rose against him, and Tian Rong's brother [[p:田横|Tian Heng]] set up Tian Rong's son [[p:田広|Tian Guang]].

events.ja: 殷王[[p:司馬卬]]は漢に捕らえられた。洛陽で{r_liu}は義帝が[[p:項羽]]に殺されたことを天下に告げ、喪に服して諸侯に討伐を呼びかけた。
events.en: [[p:司馬卬|Sima Ang]], King of Yin, was taken by Han. At Luoyang {r_liu} announced that [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] had murdered the Righteous Emperor, put on mourning, and called the lords to war.

events.ja: 洛陽の新城で三老の董公に義帝の死を告げられた{r_liu}は、袒いで声をあげて泣き、三日の喪を発した。諸侯に使いを送って「天下とともに義帝を殺した者を討とう」と呼びかけた。
events.en: At Xincheng by Luoyang the elder Dong told {r_liu} of the Righteous Emperor's death. He bared his arm, wailed and mourned three days, then sent to the lords: let all the realm strike the man who killed the emperor.

events.ja: 彭城の戦い。五十六万の諸侯の軍を率いた{r_liu}は、[[p:項羽]]の留守の彭城を落として連日酒宴を開いた。斉から三万の精兵で取って返した項羽は、一朝にして漢軍を破り、睢水は屍で流れが止まったという。[[p:劉邦]]は父と妻を捕らえられ、わずかな供と逃れた。
events.en: The battle of Pengcheng. Leading five hundred and sixty thousand men of the lords, {r_liu} took Pengcheng while [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] was away and feasted for days. Xiang Yu came back from Qi with thirty thousand picked men and broke the Han army in a morning; the Sui river, they say, was dammed with bodies. [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]]'s father and wife were taken, and he fled with a handful of men.

events.ja: 彭城で大敗した{r_liu}は滎陽に拠って敗兵を集めた。[[p:蕭何]]は関中の老人や若者まで送り出し、[[p:韓信]]は京と索の間で楚を破って、楚はそれより西へ進めなかった。
events.en: Beaten at Pengcheng, {r_liu} held Xingyang and gathered his scattered men. [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]] sent even the old men and boys of Guanzhong, and [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] beat Chu between Jing and Suo; Chu could get no further west.

events.ja: {r_liu}は水を引いて廃丘を攻め落とし、[[p:章邯]]は自害した。関中は漢のものとなった。
events.en: {r_liu} flooded Feiqiu and took it; [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] killed himself. The land within the passes was Han's.

events.ja: 漢に背いた魏王[[p:魏豹]]を、[[p:韓信]]は船を並べて見せかけたうえで上流から木の甕で兵を渡して討ち、魏を平らげた。
events.en: [[p:魏豹|Wei Bao]], King of Wei, had turned against Han; [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] lined up boats as a feint, carried his men across upstream on wooden jars, and conquered Wei.

events.ja: 井陘の戦い。[[p:韓信]]は川を背に陣を敷き ([[a:beishui|背水の陣]])、退けない兵を死に物狂いで戦わせる間に、別働隊に趙の城の旗を漢の赤旗に変えさせた。趙軍は総崩れとなり、[[p:陳余]]は討たれ、趙王歇は捕らえられた。
events.en: The battle of Jingxing. [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] drew up [[a:beishui|with a river at his back]], so his men could not retreat and fought like the desperate, while a detachment swapped the flags on the Zhao fortress for the red flags of Han. The Zhao army fell apart; [[p:陳余|Chen Yu]] was killed and [[p:趙歇|Zhao Xie]], King of Zhao, captured.

events.ja: 漢の使者随何に説かれ、九江王[[p:英布]]は楚に背いて漢についた。
events.en: Persuaded by the Han envoy Sui He, [[p:英布|Ying Bu]], King of Jiujiang, broke with Chu and went over to Han.

events.ja: [[p:陳平]]の離間の計により、[[p:項羽]]は[[p:范増]]を疑うようになった。范増は「天下の事は大いに定まった。君王みずから為されよ」と言って去り、帰る途中で背中の腫れ物が破れて死んだ。
events.en: [[p:陳平|Chen Ping]]'s ploy made [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] doubt [[p:范増|Fan Zeng]]. "The affairs of the realm are largely settled; let my lord see to them himself," Fan Zeng said, and left; on the way home a boil on his back burst, and he died.

events.ja: 滎陽を囲まれた[[p:劉邦]]の身代わりに、[[p:紀信]]が王の車に乗って東門から降伏を申し出た。その隙に劉邦は西門から逃れた。[[p:項羽]]は紀信を焼き殺した。
events.en: With [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] trapped in Xingyang, [[p:紀信|Ji Xin]] rode out of the east gate in the king's carriage to offer surrender while Liu Bang escaped by the west gate. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] burned Ji Xin alive.

events.ja: {n_chu}は滎陽を落とした。城を守っていた周苛は{r_chu}に降るよう勧められたが、罵って煮殺された。
events.en: {n_chu} took Xingyang. Zhou Ke, who had held it, was urged by {r_chu} to surrender; he cursed him instead and was boiled alive.

events.ja: [[p:酈食其]]の説得で斉王[[p:田広]]は漢と和を結び、守りを解いていた。そこへ[[p:韓信]]が攻め込んだため、欺かれたと怒った田広は酈食其を煮殺した。
events.en: Talked round by [[p:酈食其|Li Yiji]], King [[p:田広|Tian Guang]] of Qi had made peace with Han and let down his guard. Then [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] attacked; Tian Guang, believing himself betrayed, had Li Yiji boiled alive.

events.ja: 成皋を守っていた楚の大司馬曹咎は、[[p:項羽]]に「守って戦うな」と言われていたが、漢の挑発に怒って汜水を渡り、渡りかけたところを撃たれて自ら首を刎ねた。漢は成皋を取り戻し、楚の財宝を得た。
events.en: Cao Jiu, Chu's grand marshal at Chenggao, had been told by [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] to hold and not fight; goaded by Han, he lost his temper and crossed the Si river, was struck halfway over and cut his own throat. Han took back Chenggao and the treasure of Chu.

events.ja: 濰水の戦い。[[p:韓信]]は斉を攻め、救援に来た楚の[[p:龍且]]を、上流をせき止めた濰水の流れで分断して討った。[[p:酈食其]]は先に斉を説き伏せていたが、韓信の攻撃で斉王に煮殺されていた。
events.en: The battle of the Wei river. [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] attacked Qi, and when [[p:龍且|Long Ju]] came from Chu to save it, he split Long Ju's army by releasing the dammed waters of the Wei, and killed him. [[p:酈食其|Li Yiji]], who had already talked Qi into peace, had been boiled alive by the King of Qi when Han Xin attacked.

events.ja: [[p:韓信]]は斉の仮の王になることを求めた。怒る[[p:劉邦]]の足を[[p:張良]]と[[p:陳平]]が踏み、劉邦は「大丈夫ならば仮ではなく真の王になれ」と言い直して韓信を斉王とした。[[p:蒯通]]は韓信に天下三分を説いたが、韓信は劉邦の恩を思って退けた。
events.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] asked to be acting King of Qi. As [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] began to rage, [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]] and [[p:陳平|Chen Ping]] trod on his foot, and he went on: "A real man should be a real king, not an acting one," and made him King of Qi. [[p:蒯通|Kuai Tong]] urged Han Xin to divide the realm in three; remembering Liu Bang's kindness, Han Xin refused.

events.ja: 広武の対陣。{r_chu}は捕らえていた[[p:劉邦]]の父を俎の上に載せ、「降らねば煮る」と脅した。{r_liu}は「われらはともに懐王に仕えて兄弟の約束をした。わが父はお前の父だ。煮るならわたしにも一杯分けてくれ」と答えた。[[p:項羽]]は一騎打ちを挑んだが劉邦は笑って退け、項羽の罪を十数えあげたところを弩で胸を射られた。劉邦は足をさすって「賊め、わしの足の指に当ておった」と言った。
events.en: The standoff at Guangwu. {r_chu} set [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]]'s captive father on a chopping block: surrender, or he would be boiled. {r_liu} answered: "We swore brotherhood serving King Huai, so my father is your father. If you boil him, send me a cup of the soup." [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] challenged him to single combat; Liu laughed it off and was listing Xiang Yu's ten crimes when a crossbow bolt struck him in the chest. He rubbed his foot: "The villain has hit my toe."

events.ja: 漢に付いた{r_jiujiang}は、漢王によって淮南王に立てられた。
events.en: {r_jiujiang}, now on Han's side, was made King of Huainan by the King of Han.

events.ja: 鴻溝の和約。兵糧の尽きた楚と漢は、鴻溝を境に天下を二分して和を結び、[[p:項羽]]は[[p:劉邦]]の父と妻を返した。
events.en: The peace of Honggou. Short of food, Chu and Han divided the realm along the Hong canal, and [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] returned [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]]'s father and wife.

events.ja: 固陵の戦い。和約の後、[[p:張良]]と[[p:陳平]]の勧めで{r_liu}は東へ帰る楚軍を追ったが、固陵で反撃されて大敗した。約束した[[p:韓信]]と[[p:彭越]]が来なかったためで、張良の勧めで二人に広い領地を約すると、二人はすぐ兵を出した。
events.en: The battle of Guling. After the treaty, on the advice of [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]] and [[p:陳平|Chen Ping]], {r_liu} pursued the Chu army going home east, and was turned on and badly beaten at Guling: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] and [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] had not come as promised. On Zhang Liang's advice he promised them wide lands, and they marched at once.

events.ja: 垓下の戦い。和約を破って追撃した漢軍と[[p:韓信]]・[[p:彭越]]の軍に囲まれた[[p:項羽]]は、夜、四方の漢軍から楚の歌が聞こえるのを聞き ([[a:simian|四面楚歌]])、「力は山を抜き気は世を蓋う」と歌って[[p:虞美人]]と別れた。烏江のほとりで、渡しを勧める亭長に「[[a:jiangdong|江東]]の父兄に合わせる顔がない」と答え、自ら首を刎ねた。
events.en: Gaixia. Breaking the peace, the Han army, with [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] and [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]], surrounded [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]]. At night he [[a:simian|heard Chu songs from every side]] of the Han camp, sang "My strength could uproot mountains, my spirit overtopped the world," and parted from [[p:虞美人|Lady Yu]]. On the bank of the Wu river he refused the ferryman's boat — "I cannot face the elders [[a:jiangdong|east of the river]]" — and cut his own throat.

events.ja: {r_liu}は斉王の[[p:韓信]]を楚王に移して下邳を都とさせ、[[p:彭越]]を梁王とした。故郷に錦を飾った韓信は、若い頃に股をくぐらせた男を取り立てて中尉とした。
events.en: {r_liu} moved [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] from King of Qi to King of Chu, with his seat at Xiapi, and made [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] King of Liang. Home in glory, Han Xin gave an officer's post to the man who once made him crawl between his legs.

events.ja: [[p:劉邦]]は定陶の氾水の北で皇帝の位に即いた。農民の出から皇帝に昇った最初の人である。衡山王[[p:呉芮]]は長沙王とされ、九江王[[p:英布]]は淮南王となった。
events.en: [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] took the imperial throne north of the Si river at Dingtao — the first man to rise from the peasantry to emperor. [[p:呉芮|Wu Rui]] of Hengshan became King of Changsha, and [[p:英布|Ying Bu]] of Jiujiang King of Huainan.

events.ja: 洛陽の南宮での酒宴で、{r_liu}は言った。「はかりごとを帳の中にめぐらし勝ちを千里の外に決するのは[[p:張良]]に、国を治め兵糧を絶やさぬのは[[p:蕭何]]に、百万の兵を率いて必ず勝つのは[[p:韓信]]に、わしは及ばぬ。だがこの三人を用いることができた。[[p:項羽]]には[[p:范増]]一人がいたが、それすら用いられなかった。」
events.en: At a feast in the Southern Palace at Luoyang {r_liu} said: "In laying plans in a tent that win battles a thousand li away I am no match for [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]]; in governing the land and keeping the army fed, none for [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]]; in leading a million men to sure victory, none for [[p:韓信|Han Xin]]. But I could use all three. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] had one, [[p:范増|Fan Zeng]], and could not use him."

events.ja: [[p:項羽]]に従い続けた臨江王[[p:共尉]]は、漢に攻められて捕らえられた。
events.en: [[p:共尉|Gong Wei]], King of Linjiang, who had stayed loyal to [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]], was attacked and taken by Han.

events.ja: 斉の戍卒の婁敬が「関中に都すべし」と説き、[[p:張良]]もこれに賛成した。{r_liu}はその日のうちに車駕を西に向けて関中に入り、櫟陽に都した。のちに長安を都とする。
events.en: Lou Jing, a garrison soldier from Qi, urged that the capital be in Guanzhong, and [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]] agreed. That same day {r_liu} turned his carriage west into Guanzhong and made Yueyang his capital; later Chang'an would be.

events.ja: 燕王[[p:臧荼]]は漢に背いたが、皇帝自らの親征で捕らえられた。燕王には[[p:劉邦]]の幼なじみの[[p:盧綰]]が立てられた。
events.en: [[p:臧荼|Zang Tu]], King of Yan, rose against Han and was taken by the emperor's own expedition; [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]]'s childhood friend [[p:盧綰|Lu Wan]] was made King of Yan.

events.ja: 斉の[[p:田横]]は五百人の食客と海の島に逃れていたが、皇帝に召されて洛陽へ向かう途中、漢に仕えることを恥じて自ら命を絶った。島の五百人も後を追ったという。
events.en: [[p:田横|Tian Heng]] of Qi had fled to an island with five hundred followers. Summoned by the emperor, he killed himself on the road to Luoyang rather than serve Han; the five hundred on the island followed him in death, it is said.

deploy.ja: 秦の[[p:王離]]は二十万で鉅鹿の趙を囲み、[[p:章邯]]が甬道 (壁で囲った補給路) で兵糧を送っていた。救援の諸侯の軍は十余りの陣を並べながら、誰も動かなかった。楚の将[[p:宋義]]も四十六日間進まなかった。
deploy.en: [[p:王離|Wang Li]] of Qin had Julu and the King of Zhao besieged with two hundred thousand, fed by [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] along a walled supply road. More than ten armies of the lords had come to help and sat in their camps; the Chu general [[p:宋義|Song Yi]] waited forty-six days without moving.

plan.ja: [[p:項羽]]は[[p:宋義]]を斬って全軍を握ると、[[p:英布]]らに河を渡らせて甬道を断たせ、自らも全軍で渡河した。渡り終えると船を沈め、釜と甑を壊し、宿営を焼き、三日分の食糧だけを持たせた (破釜沈舟)。楚兵は「一人で十人に当たり」、九度戦って秦軍を破り、[[p:王離]]を捕らえた。
plan.en: [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] killed [[p:宋義|Song Yi]], took the army, sent [[p:英布|Ying Bu]] ahead across the river to cut the supply road, and crossed with everyone. Then he sank the boats, smashed the cooking pots, burned the huts, and gave each man three days' food. "Each man of Chu fought ten," and in nine fights they broke the Qin army and took [[p:王離|Wang Li]] prisoner.

tales.ja: 戦いの間、諸侯の将たちは自陣の塁の上から見物するばかりであった。戦いの後、[[p:項羽]]の陣に呼ばれた彼らは、膝で這って進み、顔を上げることもできなかった。
tales.en: All through the battle the generals of the lords only watched from their ramparts. Afterwards, summoned to [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]]'s camp, they came in on their knees and dared not look up.

after.ja: [[p:章邯]]は二十万とともに降ったが、[[p:項羽]]は新安でその兵を夜のうちに穴埋めにしたと伝わる。項羽は諸侯の上将軍となった。
after.en: [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] surrendered with two hundred thousand men; at Xin'an, the records say, [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] had them buried alive in a night. He became supreme general of the lords.

deploy.ja: [[p:項羽]]が斉で[[p:田栄]]と戦っている間に、[[p:劉邦]]は五諸侯の兵五十六万を率いて楚の都彭城に入った。劉邦は財宝と美女を収め、毎日酒宴を開いた。
deploy.en: While [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] fought [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] in Qi, [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] led the armies of five lords, five hundred and sixty thousand men, into the Chu capital Pengcheng, took its treasure and its women, and feasted every day.

plan.ja: [[p:項羽]]は精鋭三万騎だけを率いて引き返し、夜明けに西から奇襲した。昼までに漢軍は崩れ、穀水・泗水と睢水に追い落とされた十万余りの屍で、睢水の流れがせき止められたという。
plan.en: [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] came back with only thirty thousand picked horse and struck from the west at dawn. By noon the Han army had broken; driven into the Gu, the Si and the Sui, more than a hundred thousand drowned, and the Sui, they say, was dammed with bodies.

tales.ja: 楚軍に三重に囲まれた[[p:劉邦]]を、西北から吹いた大風が救った。木を折り家を倒し、砂を巻き上げて昼を夜のように暗くしたため、劉邦は数十騎で囲みを抜けた。
tales.en: Surrounded three deep, [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] was saved by a great wind from the northwest that broke trees and flattened houses and filled the day with sand like night; he slipped away with a few dozen horsemen.

tales.ja: 逃げる車が重いと、[[p:劉邦]]は自分の子 (のちの恵帝と魯元公主) を三度も車から突き落とし、そのたびに御者の[[p:夏侯嬰]]が拾い上げた。
tales.en: To lighten his carriage [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] three times pushed his own children — the future Emperor Hui and Princess Luyuan — out of it, and three times the driver [[p:夏侯嬰|Xiahou Ying]] picked them up.

after.ja: [[p:劉邦]]の父と妻[[p:呂雉]]は楚の捕虜となり、諸侯の多くは楚へ寝返った。劉邦は滎陽で長い持久戦に入る。
after.en: [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]]'s father and his wife [[p:呂雉|Lü Zhi]] were taken by Chu, and most of the lords went over to [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]]. Liu Bang dug in at Xingyang for a long war.

deploy.ja: [[p:韓信]]は数万で太行山の狭い井陘口を越えて趙へ向かった。趙は二十万と号する兵を口の出口に集めた。趙の李左車は「道は狭く兵糧は後ろに残る。三万で退路を断てば十日で韓信の首を取れる」と説いたが、[[p:陳余]]は「義兵は詐謀を用いない」と退けた。
deploy.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] crossed the narrow Jingxing pass in the Taihang mountains with a few tens of thousands. Zhao gathered a host said to be two hundred thousand at its mouth. Li Zuoju urged [[p:陳余|Chen Yu]] to send thirty thousand to cut the road behind — "the pass is narrow, his grain is in the rear; in ten days I will bring you his head" — but Chen Yu replied that a righteous army does not use tricks.

plan.ja: [[p:韓信]]は夜のうちに二千の騎兵にそれぞれ漢の赤い旗を持たせて山に潜ませた。朝、一万の兵に川を背にして陣を敷かせると、趙兵は兵法を知らぬと笑った。韓信は大将の旗を立てて打って出、わざと負けて川辺の陣へ逃げ込んだ。逃げ場のない兵は死に物狂いで戦った。その間に伏兵が空になった趙の砦に入り、漢の旗二千本を立てた。振り返った趙兵は砦が落ちたと思い込み、総崩れとなった。
plan.en: By night [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] hid two thousand horsemen in the hills, each with a red Han flag. In the morning he set ten thousand men with their backs to the river; the Zhao soldiers laughed at a general who knew nothing of war. He came out under his own standard, gave way on purpose and fell back into the river camp, where men with nowhere to run fought for their lives. Meanwhile the hidden horsemen rode into the emptied Zhao forts and raised two thousand Han flags. Looking back, the Zhao army thought its camp had fallen and broke.

tales.ja: 勝った後、将たちが「兵法では山を背にし水を前にせよと言うのに」と尋ねると、[[p:韓信]]は「兵法に『死地に陥れて後に生く』とあるではないか。寄せ集めの兵は、死地に置かねば逃げ散るのだ」と答えた (背水の陣)。
tales.en: Afterwards his officers asked why he had broken the rule of keeping hills behind and water in front. "Does the art of war not say: put them on deadly ground, and they will live? My men were a rabble; anywhere else they would have run." — the origin of "back to the water".

tales.ja: [[p:韓信]]は捕らえた李左車の縄を自ら解いて師の礼で迎え、燕を攻める策を問うた。李左車は「敗軍の将は兵を語らず」と一度は断ったが、のちに戦わずして燕を降す策を授けた。
tales.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] untied the captive Li Zuoju with his own hands, sat him as a teacher and asked how to take Yan. "A beaten general does not talk of war," Li said at first — then gave him a plan that won Yan without a fight.

after.ja: [[p:陳余]]は泜水のほとりで斬られ、趙王歇は捕らえられた。燕は使者一人で降った。
after.en: [[p:陳余|Chen Yu]] was beheaded by the Zhi river and King Xie of Zhao captured; Yan surrendered to a single envoy.

name.en: the battle of the Wei river

plan.ja: [[p:韓信]]は夜のうちに一万余りの土嚢で濰水の上流をせき止めさせた。翌朝、兵を率いて半ば川を渡って打ちかかり、すぐに負けたふりをして退いた。[[p:龍且]]は「韓信が臆病なのは知っている」と追って渡り始めた。そこで土嚢を切ると水がどっと流れ下り、楚軍の大半は渡れずに分断された。渡った龍且は討たれた。
plan.en: By night [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] had the Wei river dammed upstream with more than ten thousand sandbags. In the morning he led his men half across, attacked, and soon fell back as if beaten. "I always knew Han Xin was a coward," said [[p:龍且|Long Ju]], and followed him into the river. Then the sandbags were cut; the water came down and split the Chu army, most of it unable to cross. Long Ju, on the near bank, was killed.

tales.ja: この勝利の後、[[p:韓信]]は[[p:劉邦]]に「斉は偽りの多い国、仮の王を置かねば治まりません」と斉王の位を求めた。劉邦は怒りかけたが、[[p:張良]]と[[p:陳平]]に足を踏まれて気づき、「どうせなら本当の王になれ」と言い直した。
tales.en: After the victory [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] asked [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] to make him "acting king" of Qi, a treacherous land. Liu Bang began to rage — until [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]] and [[p:陳平|Chen Ping]] trod on his foot — and said instead: "Why acting? Be a real king."

tales.ja: [[p:蒯通]]は[[p:韓信]]に「天下を三分して、漢・楚と鼎の足のように立て」と説いたが、韓信は[[p:劉邦]]の恩を思って従わなかった。
tales.en: [[p:蒯通|Kuai Tong]] urged [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] to split the realm in three and stand with Han and Chu like the legs of a tripod; remembering what he owed [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]], Han Xin refused.

after.ja: 斉は[[p:韓信]]のものとなり、楚は東の守りを失った。[[p:項羽]]は和を求め、天下を鴻溝で二分する約が結ばれる。
after.en: Qi fell to [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] and Chu lost its eastern shield. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] sought peace, and the realm was divided at the Hong canal.

deploy.ja: 鴻溝の約を破った[[p:劉邦]]は[[p:項羽]]を追い、[[p:韓信]]・[[p:彭越]]・[[p:英布]]の軍が合流した。韓信が三十万で中央に立ち、孔将軍・費将軍が左右を固め、劉邦がその後ろにいた。
deploy.en: Breaking the treaty of the Hong canal, [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] went after [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] and was joined by the armies of [[p:韓信|Han Xin]], [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] and [[p:英布|Ying Bu]]. Han Xin stood in the centre with three hundred thousand, Generals Kong and Fei on his wings, Liu Bang behind.

plan.ja: [[p:韓信]]は中央を退かせて楚軍を誘い込み、左右の軍に挟ませた。楚軍は垓下の塁に追い込まれ、兵は少なく、食糧も尽きた。夜、四方を囲む漢軍の中から楚の歌が聞こえてきた。
plan.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] let his centre give ground, drew the Chu army in and closed the wings on it. Driven back into its ramparts at Gaixia, Chu had few men and no food. At night, from the Han army all around, came the songs of Chu.

tales.ja: 「漢はもう楚を取ったのか、なんと楚人の多いことか」。四面楚歌を聞いた[[p:項羽]]は帳の中で酒を飲み、「力は山を抜き、気は世を蓋う……虞や虞や汝を如何せん」と歌った。左右の者はみな泣いた。
tales.en: "Has Han taken Chu already? How many men of Chu there are!" Hearing Chu songs on every side, [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] drank in his tent and sang: "My strength could uproot mountains, my spirit overtop the world… Yu, my Yu, what will become of you?" Everyone around him wept.

tales.ja: [[p:項羽]]は八百騎で囲みを破って南へ逃れたが、田の老人に道を偽られて沼地に迷い込んだ。東城で二十八騎になると「天が我を亡ぼすのであって、戦が拙いのではない」と言い、三度囲みを破って証を見せた。
tales.en: [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] broke out with eight hundred horse and fled south, but an old farmer misled him into a marsh. Down to twenty-eight riders at Dongcheng, he said: "It is heaven that destroys me, not my skill at war," and broke the ring three times to prove it.

tales.ja: 烏江の亭長は舟を用意して江東へ渡るよう勧めたが、[[p:項羽]]は「江東の子弟八千と渡ったのに、今一人も還らない。何の面目があって父兄に会えようか」と笑って断り、愛馬の騅を亭長に贈り、自ら首を刎ねた。
tales.en: At the Wu river the ferry master had a boat ready to take him home. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] laughed: "Eight thousand young men of the south crossed with me, and not one returns; how could I face their fathers?" He gave his horse Zhui to the ferryman, and cut his own throat.

after.ja: 楚は滅び、[[p:劉邦]]は皇帝の位についた。漢の四百年が始まる。
after.en: Chu was gone and [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] took the imperial throne; four hundred years of Han began.

deploy.ja: [[p:陳勝]]を破った[[p:章邯]]は魏の都の臨済を囲んだ。魏王の[[p:魏咎]]は斉と楚に救いを求め、斉王の[[p:田儋]]が自ら兵を率いて来た。
deploy.en: Having crushed [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]], [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] besieged Linji, the seat of Wei. King [[p:魏咎|Wei Jiu]] begged Qi and Chu for help, and King [[p:田儋|Tian Dan]] of Qi came with his army in person.

plan.ja: [[p:章邯]]は兵に枚を銜ませて夜のうちに攻め寄せ、斉と魏の救援軍を城の下で大いに破った。[[p:田儋]]は討死した。
plan.en: [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] had his men march gagged by night, fell on the Qi and Wei relief army beneath the walls and routed it. [[p:田儋|Tian Dan]] was killed.

after.ja: [[p:魏咎]]は民の命と引き換えに降ることを約し、約束が結ばれると自ら火に入って死んだ。弟の[[p:魏豹]]は楚へ逃れた。
after.en: [[p:魏咎|Wei Jiu]] agreed to surrender on condition that his people be spared; once it was sworn, he walked into the fire. His brother [[p:魏豹|Wei Bao]] fled to Chu.

deploy.ja: 東阿と濮陽で[[p:章邯]]を破った[[p:項梁]]は、定陶でも秦軍を破り、秦を軽んじるようになった。[[p:宋義]]は「勝って将が驕り兵が怠けるのは負ける兆し」と諫めたが聞かれなかった。秦は章邯に大軍を送り足した。
deploy.en: [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] had beaten [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] at Dong'e and Puyang and again at Dingtao, and began to hold Qin cheap. "When a winning general grows proud and his men slack, defeat is near," [[p:宋義|Song Yi]] warned, unheard. Qin sent Zhang Han large reinforcements.

plan.ja: [[p:章邯]]は兵に枚を銜ませて夜襲をかけ、油断していた楚軍を大いに破った。
plan.en: [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] attacked by night, his men gagged for silence, and broke the unwary Chu army.

after.ja: [[p:項梁]]は戦死した。[[p:項羽]]と[[p:劉邦]]は兵を引いて彭城の近くに陣を移し、懐王は盱眙から彭城に移った。[[p:章邯]]は楚を恐れるに足らずとみて、北の趙へ向かった。
after.en: [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] was killed. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] and [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] pulled back near Pengcheng, and King Huai moved there from Xuyi. Thinking Chu no longer a threat, [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] turned north against Zhao.

deploy.ja: 焼いた桟道を直すと見せかけておいて、漢軍はひそかに故道を通って陳倉に出た。雍王の[[p:章邯]]は陳倉で迎え撃った。
deploy.en: Making a show of repairing the burned plank roads, the Han army slipped out by the old road to Chencang. [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]], King of Yong, met it there.

plan.ja: 不意を突かれた雍の軍は陳倉で敗れ、好畤でも敗れて、[[p:章邯]]は廃丘に退いた。
plan.en: Caught off guard, the Yong army was beaten at Chencang and again at Haozhi, and [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] fell back to Feiqiu.

after.ja: 塞王の[[p:司馬欣]]と翟王の[[p:董翳]]は戦わずに降った。[[p:章邯]]は廃丘に籠もり、漢はこれを十か月にわたって囲んだ。
after.en: [[p:司馬欣|Sima Xin]], King of Sai, and [[p:董翳|Dong Yi]], King of Di, surrendered without a fight. [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] held Feiqiu, and Han besieged it for ten months.

deploy.ja: [[p:項羽]]の立てた斉の王たちを攻め殺して斉を一つにした[[p:田栄]]は、[[p:彭越]]を使って梁の地でも楚を乱していた。項羽は自ら北へ兵を進めた。
deploy.en: [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] had killed the kings [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] set up in Qi, united it, and was using [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] to make trouble for Chu in Liang. Xiang Yu marched north himself.

plan.ja: 両軍は城陽で戦い、[[p:田栄]]は敗れて平原へ逃げた。
plan.en: The armies met at Chengyang; [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] was beaten and fled to Pingyuan.

after.ja: [[p:田栄]]は平原の民に殺された。[[p:項羽]]は斉を焼き払い、降った兵を穴埋めにしたため、斉の人々はかえって集まって背いた。項羽が斉にかかりきりになっている間に、[[p:劉邦]]は彭城を突いた。
after.en: The people of Pingyuan killed [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]]. [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] burned Qi and buried its surrendered soldiers alive, and the people of Qi only gathered and rose again. While he was tied down in Qi, [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] struck at Pengcheng.

deploy.ja: 彭城の敗戦の後に漢に背いた魏王の[[p:魏豹]]は、河の渡し場の臨晋を固めて漢軍を防いだ。
deploy.en: [[p:魏豹|Wei Bao]], King of Wei, who had turned against Han after the defeat at Pengcheng, held the river crossing at Linjin against the Han army.

plan.ja: [[p:韓信]]は臨晋の向かいに多くの船を並べて渡ると見せかけ、上流の夏陽から木の甕を連ねて兵を渡し、魏の都の安邑を突いた。
plan.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] lined up boats opposite Linjin as though to cross there, then took his men over upstream at Xiayang on rafts of wooden jars and struck Anyi, the seat of Wei.

after.ja: [[p:魏豹]]は捕らえられ、魏の地は漢の河東・太原・上党の郡となった。[[p:韓信]]はそのまま北の代と趙へ向かった。
after.en: [[p:魏豹|Wei Bao]] was captured and Wei became the Han commanderies of Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang. [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] went straight on north against Dai and Zhao.

deploy.ja: 鴻溝の和約で東へ帰る楚軍を、[[p:張良]]と[[p:陳平]]は「楚の兵は疲れ兵糧も尽きている。今討たねば虎を養って患いを残す」と言って追わせた。[[p:劉邦]]は[[p:韓信]]・[[p:彭越]]と固陵で落ち合う約束をして追った。
deploy.en: "Chu's men are worn out and its food is gone," [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]] and [[p:陳平|Chen Ping]] said as the Chu army went home east under the Hong canal treaty. "Let it go now and you are rearing a tiger." [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] pursued, agreeing to meet [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] and [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] at Guling.

plan.ja: [[p:韓信]]と[[p:彭越]]は来なかった。楚軍は振り返って漢軍を打ち破り、[[p:劉邦]]は塁を深くして守った。
plan.en: [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] and [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] did not come. The Chu army turned and broke the Han army, and [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] dug in deep behind his walls.

after.ja: [[p:張良]]の勧めで、[[p:劉邦]]は[[p:韓信]]と[[p:彭越]]に陳より東の海までと睢陽より北の穀城までの地を約した。二人はすぐ兵を出し、楚軍は垓下へ追い込まれていく。
after.en: On [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]]'s advice [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] promised [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] everything east of Chen to the sea, and [[p:彭越|Peng Yue]] everything north of Suiyang to Gucheng. They marched at once, and the Chu army was driven toward Gaixia.

name.ja: 反秦の戦い (鉅鹿の救援)
name.en: the war against Qin (the relief of Julu)

terms.ja: [[p:章邯]]は殷墟で二十万とともに[[p:項羽]]に降り、雍王に封じられた。
terms.en: At the ruins of Yin [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] surrendered to [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] with two hundred thousand men and was made King of Yong.

terms.ja: [[p:田栄]]は平原で敗れて殺されたが、弟の[[p:田横]]が斉を立て直し、[[p:劉邦]]の彭城入りを聞いた[[p:項羽]]は斉を離れた。
terms.en: [[p:田栄|Tian Rong]] was beaten at Pingyuan and killed, but his brother [[p:田横|Tian Heng]] rebuilt Qi, and [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]], hearing that [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] had taken Pengcheng, left Qi.

name.en: Liu Bang's conquest of the Three Qins

terms.ja: 漢は廃丘に水を引き入れて落とし、[[p:章邯]]は自害した。雍の地は漢の郡となった。
terms.en: Han flooded Feiqiu and took it; [[p:章邯|Zhang Han]] killed himself, and Yong became Han commanderies.

terms.ja: [[p:魏豹]]は捕らえられて滎陽の守りに回され、魏の地は漢の郡となった。
terms.en: [[p:魏豹|Wei Bao]] was taken and set to guard Xingyang, and Wei became Han commanderies.

terms.ja: [[p:陳余]]は斬られ、趙王歇は捕らえられた。[[p:張耳]]が趙王となり、燕は戦わずに降った。
terms.en: [[p:陳余|Chen Yu]] was beheaded and King Xie of Zhao captured; [[p:張耳|Zhang Er]] became King of Zhao, and Yan surrendered without a fight.

terms.ja: [[p:項羽]]は烏江で自害し、楚の地はすべて漢に下った。最後まで降らなかった魯も、項羽の首を見せられて門を開いた。[[p:劉邦]]は項羽を魯公の礼で葬った。
terms.en: [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] took his life at the Wu river and all Chu submitted to Han. Lu, the last to hold out, opened its gates when shown his head; [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] buried him with the rites of a Duke of Lu.

title.en: The eight thousand young men east of the river

body.ja:
前209年、[[p:項梁]]と甥の[[p:項羽]]は会稽で郡守を斬って兵を挙げ、江東 (長江下流の南岸) の若者八千人を率いて長江を渡った。

彼らが項羽の軍の芯となった。鉅鹿で「一人で十人に当たった」楚兵、彭城で三万で五十六万を破った騎兵の中心には、江東の子弟がいた。項羽は兵を慈しみ、病む者があれば涙を流して自分の食べ物を分けたという。その一方で、手柄を立てた者に与える印綬を手の中でもてあそび、角がすり減るまで渡せなかった、とかつての部下[[p:韓信]]は語っている。

垓下ののち、烏江の亭長に江東へ渡るよう勧められた項羽は、「江東の子弟八千と河を渡ったのに、今一人も還らない。江東の父兄が憐れんで王にしてくれても、どんな顔で会えようか」と断った。唐の詩人杜牧は、烏江の宿駅に立ってこう詠んで、項羽が渡らなかったことを惜しんだ。「江東の子弟には才ある者が多い。土煙を巻いて、もう一度攻め上ったかもしれないのに」(捲土重来)。
body.en:
In 209 BC [[p:項梁|Xiang Liang]] and his nephew [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] killed the governor of Kuaiji, raised their banner and crossed the Yangzi with eight thousand young men from east of the river.

They were the heart of Xiang Yu's army: the men of Chu who "each fought ten" at Julu, the core of the horsemen who broke five hundred and sixty thousand with thirty thousand at Pengcheng. Xiang Yu loved his soldiers, and would weep and share his own food with the sick — yet, said his former officer [[p:韓信|Han Xin]], when a man earned a fief he would turn the seal over and over in his hand until its corners wore away, unable to give it up.

After Gaixia, offered a boat home by the ferry master of the Wu river, Xiang Yu refused: "I crossed with eight thousand young men east of the river, and not one returns. Even if their fathers took pity and made me king, how could I face them?" Centuries later the Tang poet Du Mu, standing at the ferry station, regretted it: there were many able men east of the river, and he might have come back "rolling up the dust" to try again.

body.ja:
楼煩は、今の山西北部にいた遊牧の民。馬上から弓を射る技に優れ、趙の武霊王が胡服騎射を始めたときの手本の一つとなった。武霊王に討たれたのち、その騎兵は趙の軍に組み込まれた。

楚漢戦争の頃には、「楼煩」は騎射の巧みな兵の呼び名となっていた。広武で両軍が向き合ったとき、楚の勇士が三度挑戦に出ると、漢軍の楼煩の兵がそのたびに射殺した。怒った[[p:項羽]]が自ら鎧を着て戟を取って出ると、項羽が目を怒らせて叱りつけただけで、楼煩の兵は目を合わせることもできず、手が震えて射られないまま、陣に逃げ帰ったという。

漢は[[p:灌嬰]]に騎兵を率いさせ、秦の騎兵出身の李必と駱甲を補佐に付けて、騎兵の部隊を作った。垓下の戦いのあと項羽を追い、烏江で追いついたのも灌嬰の騎兵であった。
body.en:
The Loufan were herders of what is now northern Shanxi, masters of shooting from horseback — one of the models for King Wuling of Zhao's mounted archers. Conquered by him, their horsemen were taken into the army of Zhao.

By the Chu–Han war "Loufan" had become the name for any skilled horse archer. When the armies faced each other at Guangwu and a Chu champion rode out three times to challenge, a Loufan bowman on the Han side shot him down each time. Furious, [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] put on his armour and rode out himself; he only glared and roared at the archer, who could not meet his eyes, could not loose for the shaking of his hands, and fled back to his lines.

Han formed its own cavalry under [[p:灌嬰|Guan Ying]], with two former Qin cavalry officers, Li Bi and Luo Jia, as his lieutenants. It was Guan Ying's horsemen who hunted Xiang Yu after Gaixia and caught him at the Wu river.

body.ja:
鳴鏑 (なりかぶら) は、鏃の後ろに穴の開いた骨や木の玉を付け、飛ぶと音を立てる矢である。合図や、敵を脅すのに使われた。

匈奴の太子冒頓は父の[[p:頭曼単于]]に疎まれ、月氏に人質に出されたうえ、その月氏を父に攻められた。月氏の馬を盗んで逃げ帰った冒頓は鳴鏑を作り、部下に「鳴鏑の射る先を射ない者は斬る」と命じた。狩りでは獲物を、次には自分の愛馬を、さらには愛する妻を射た。ためらった者は斬られた。最後に父の愛馬を射させると、もう一人もためらわなかった。

前209年、父の狩りに従った冒頓が父へ鳴鏑を放つと、部下たちは一斉に頭曼を射殺した。冒頓は単于となり、東の東胡を滅ぼし、西の月氏を追い払い、北の草原を一つにまとめた。

前200年、冒頓は白登山で漢の高祖[[p:劉邦]]を七日間囲んだ。[[p:陳平]]の策で囲みを抜けた劉邦は、その後、匈奴に一族の娘を嫁がせ、毎年絹や酒、食物を贈る「和親」を結んだ。漢がこれを改めるには、武帝の時代を待たねばならなかった。
body.en:
A whistling arrow carries a pierced ball of bone or wood behind the head that sings as it flies; it served for signals and to frighten an enemy.

Modu, heir of the Xiongnu, fell out of his father Touman's favour: he was sent as a hostage to the Yuezhi, whom his father then attacked. Modu stole a Yuezhi horse and escaped home. He made whistling arrows and told his men: "Whoever does not shoot where my arrow flies will die." He shot at game; then at his own best horse; then at his beloved wife. Those who hesitated were beheaded. When at last he shot at his father's favourite horse, no one hesitated.

In 209 BC, out hunting with his father, Modu loosed a whistling arrow at Touman, and his men shot him dead as one. Modu became chanyu, destroyed the Donghu in the east, drove the Yuezhi west and united the northern steppe.

In 200 BC he surrounded [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]], the first Han emperor, on Mount Baideng for seven days. Escaping through a ruse of [[p:陳平|Chen Ping]]'s, Liu Bang made the "peace through kinship": a princess of his house for the chanyu and gifts of silk, wine and food every year. Han did not change it until the reign of Emperor Wu.

body.ja:
秦は、黄河と済水が分かれる滎陽の西北、敖山の上に巨大な穀倉を築いた。東方の穀物を集めて関中へ送るための倉で、楚漢戦争の頃にも大量の穀物が眠っていた。

彭城で大敗した[[p:劉邦]]は、滎陽に踏みとどまった。[[p:酈食其]]は「王者は民を天とし、民は食を天とします。敖倉を押さえれば天下の形勢は決まります」と説いた。劉邦は敖倉を守り、壁で囲った道 (甬道) を黄河まで築いて兵糧を運ばせた。

[[p:項羽]]はこの甬道を何度も襲って断ち、漢軍は飢えに苦しんだ。それでも敖倉を手放さなかったことが、長い持久戦を漢の勝ちに導いた。食を握る者が戦を制したのである。
body.en:
Qin built a vast granary on Mount Ao, northwest of Xingyang where the Ji branches from the Yellow River, to gather the grain of the east for the capital. In the Chu–Han war it still held great stores.

Routed at Pengcheng, [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] dug in at Xingyang. "A king makes the people his heaven, and the people make food their heaven," [[p:酈食其|Li Yiji]] told him. "Hold the Ao granary and the realm is yours." Liu Bang held it, and built a walled road down to the river to bring the grain in.

[[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]] cut the walled road again and again, and the Han army went hungry; yet keeping the granary won Han the long war. Whoever held the food won.

title.ja: 巴蜀の米と蕭何の兵站
title.en: The rice of Ba and Shu, and Xiao He's supply lines

body.ja:
蜀の成都平原は、秦の李冰が築いた都江堰の水路のおかげで、日照りにも洪水にも強い豊かな田となった。「天府の国」(天の蔵) と呼ばれたのはこの頃からである。

[[p:項羽]]に辺境の巴・蜀・漢中の王にされた[[p:劉邦]]は、はじめ不満だったが、[[p:蕭何]]に「漢中で王となり、民を養い、賢者を招き、巴蜀を使って三秦を取りましょう」と説かれた。

劉邦が東で項羽と戦う間、蕭何は関中と巴蜀を治め、兵と兵糧を絶え間なく前線へ送り続けた。劉邦が何度負けても立ち直れたのは、そのためである。天下を取った後、劉邦は功の第一を蕭何とした。「獣を追い殺すのは犬だが、犬に獣の居場所を指し示すのは人である」と言って。
body.en:
The Chengdu plain of Shu, watered by the Dujiangyan canals that Li Bing of Qin had built, became rich land safe from drought and flood — the "Storehouse of Heaven".

Made king of the remote lands of Ba, Shu and Hanzhong by [[p:項羽|Xiang Yu]], [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] was bitter at first; but [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]] urged him to be king in Hanzhong, feed the people, draw in able men, and use Ba and Shu to take the three Qin kingdoms.

While Liu Bang fought Xiang Yu in the east, Xiao He governed Guanzhong and Ba-Shu and sent men and grain to the front without fail; that is why Liu Bang could recover from defeat after defeat. Victorious, he ranked Xiao He first in merit: "It is the hound that runs down the hare, but the man who shows the hound where the hare is."

body.ja:
海に面した斉は、魚と塩、そして絹の国であった。都の臨淄は戦国以来の大都市で、[[p:韓信]]が斉を攻め取ったとき、その富と七十余りの城は天下の大きな部分を占めていた。

韓信が[[p:劉邦]]に「斉の仮の王にしてほしい」と求めたのは、この豊かな国を治めるのに力が要ったからでもある。[[p:蒯通]]が韓信に、楚・漢と並んで天下を三分せよと説いたのも、斉の富を背景にしてのことだった。

斉の王族[[p:田横]]は、漢に降るのを潔しとせず、五百人の部下と海の島に逃れた。劉邦に呼ばれて都へ向かう途中、自ら首を刎ね、それを聞いた島の五百人もみな後を追ったという。
body.en:
Qi, on the sea, was a land of fish, salt and silk; its capital Linzi had been a great city since the Warring States. When [[p:韓信|Han Xin]] took Qi, its wealth and its seventy-odd cities made up a large part of the realm.

That is partly why Han Xin asked [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] to make him acting king of Qi: such a rich land took power to hold. And [[p:蒯通|Kuai Tong]]'s plan for Han Xin to stand as a third power beside Chu and Han rested on the wealth of Qi.

[[p:田横|Tian Heng]], of the royal house of Qi, would not submit to Han and fled with five hundred followers to an island. Summoned by Liu Bang, he cut his own throat on the way to the capital, and when the five hundred on the island heard, they all followed him in death.

body.ja:
北の草原の匈奴は、馬とともに生きる民であった。子どもは羊に乗って弓を引き、少し大きくなると狐や兎を射て食べ、大人の男はみな弓を引いて騎兵になった、と『史記』は書く。

前200年、白登山で漢の高祖[[p:劉邦]]を囲んだ[[p:冒頓単于]]の騎兵は四十万と号した。西にはすべて白い馬、東にはすべて青みがかった馬、北にはすべて黒い馬、南にはすべて赤い馬——四方を馬の色で分けて並べたという。

一方の漢は、長い戦乱で馬が尽きていた。皇帝の車を引く同じ毛色の馬四頭さえそろえられず、将軍や宰相は牛車に乗っていた、と『史記』は伝える。漢が馬を育て、匈奴と騎兵で渡り合えるようになるのは、六十年以上後の武帝の時代である。
body.en:
The Xiongnu of the northern steppe lived with their horses. Their boys rode sheep and shot birds and rats, says the Records of the Grand Historian; a little older they shot foxes and hares for food, and every grown man could draw a bow and ride as a cavalryman.

In 200 BC the horsemen with whom [[p:冒頓単于|Modu Chanyu]] surrounded [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] on Mount Baideng were said to number four hundred thousand — white horses all on the west, grey on the east, black on the north and red on the south.

Han, by contrast, had run out of horses in the long wars. The emperor could not find four of one colour for his carriage, and generals and ministers rode in ox carts. Only sixty years later, under Emperor Wu, could Han meet the Xiongnu horse for horse.

body.ja:
秦は法で治める国であった。1975年、湖北の睡虎地で、秦の地方役人「喜」の墓から千枚を超える竹簡が見つかった。そこには秦の法律と、役人の仕事の手引きが細かく書かれていた。

桑の葉を盗んだ者は、値が一銭に満たなくても三十日の労役。役所の牛が痩せれば係の者が罰を受ける。罪を告げた者には褒美。何もかもが文字に書かれ、役人はそれに従って裁いた。

[[p:陳勝]]・[[p:呉広]]の乱は、雨で期日に遅れた兵が「遅れれば死刑」と恐れて起こしたと『史記』は書く。ところが睡虎地の竹簡では、労役への遅れは罰金や叱責にとどまっていた。死刑とされたのは軍の期日の遅れだったのか、それとも乱を起こすための口実だったのか——史料が新しい問いを投げかけている。
body.en:
Qin was a state ruled by law. In 1975, in the tomb of a Qin local official named Xi at Shuihudi in Hubei, more than a thousand bamboo slips were found: Qin statutes and a handbook for officials, written out in detail.

A man who stole mulberry leaves worth less than one coin served thirty days' labour; if the office oxen grew thin, their keeper was punished; informers were rewarded. Everything was in writing, and officials judged by it.

The rising of [[p:陳勝|Chen Sheng]] and [[p:呉広|Wu Guang]] began, says the Records of the Grand Historian, when conscripts delayed by rain feared that lateness meant death. Yet in the Shuihudi slips, lateness for labour service brought only a fine or a reprimand. Was the death penalty for being late with an army, or an excuse to rebel? The new sources raise new questions.

body.ja:
前207年の冬、[[p:劉邦]]は武関から関中に入り、秦王[[p:子嬰]]の降伏を受けた。宮殿の財宝と美女に心を奪われかけた劉邦を、[[p:樊噲]]と[[p:張良]]がいさめ、劉邦は覇上の陣に戻った。

劉邦は関中の長老たちを集めて言った。「皆は長く秦の苛酷な法に苦しんできた。私は皆と約束しよう。法はただ三章。人を殺した者は死罪、人を傷つけた者と盗んだ者は、それぞれの罪に応じて罰する。それ以外の秦の法はすべて除く」。

秦の民は大いに喜び、牛や羊、酒を持って兵をもてなそうとした。劉邦は「倉には穀物が多い。民に負担をかけたくない」と受け取らなかった。民はますます喜び、劉邦が関中の王にならないことを恐れたという。同じ時、[[p:蕭何]]はただ一人、秦の役所の法令・地図・戸籍を集めて持ち出した。これがのちに、漢が天下の地形と人口を知る元となった。
body.en:
In the winter of 207 BC [[p:劉邦|Liu Bang]] entered Guanzhong through the Wu pass and received the surrender of [[p:子嬰|Ziying]], King of Qin. Tempted by the treasures and women of the palace, he was talked out of it by [[p:樊噲|Fan Kuai]] and [[p:張良|Zhang Liang]] and went back to his camp at Bashang.

He called together the elders of Guanzhong: "You have long suffered under the cruel laws of Qin. I make you this promise: three laws only. Whoever kills shall die; whoever wounds or steals shall be punished according to the crime. All the other laws of Qin are abolished."

The people of Qin rejoiced and brought oxen, sheep and wine for his soldiers. Liu Bang refused them: the granaries were full and he would not burden the people. They loved him all the more and feared only that he might not become their king. Meanwhile [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]] alone gathered up the laws, maps and registers of the Qin offices — the knowledge by which Han would later know the land and people of the whole realm.

body.ja:
天下を取った漢は、法三章だけでは国を治められなかった。[[p:蕭何]]は秦の法を取捨し、李悝の『法経』六篇に、戸 (戸籍)・興 (労役)・厩 (馬と倉) の三篇を加えて「九章律」とした。

蕭何が死ぬと、後を継いだ[[p:曹参]]は蕭何の決めたことを何一つ変えず、毎日酒を飲んでいた。いぶかる恵帝に曹参は尋ねた。「陛下と高祖では、どちらが優れておられますか」「高祖には及ばない」「私と蕭何では」「及ばないようだ」「では、高祖と蕭何が定めたものを、私たちが守っていればよいのです」。「蕭規曹随」(蕭何が規を作り、曹参が随う) という言葉はここから生まれた。
body.en:
Victorious Han could not rule the realm on three laws. [[p:蕭何|Xiao He]] sifted the laws of Qin and added three chapters — households, labour service, stables and granaries — to Li Kui's six-part Canon, making the Nine Chapters.

When Xiao He died his successor Cao Can changed nothing he had set down, and drank wine every day. When the puzzled Emperor Hui asked why, Cao Can asked him: "Who is the greater, Your Majesty or the founder?" "I cannot match the founder." "And I or Xiao He?" "You seem not his equal." "Then if we keep what the founder and Xiao He laid down, that is enough." Hence the saying "Xiao made the rules and Cao followed them".

title.en: The teaching of the Yellow Emperor and Laozi

body.ja:
秦の厳しい法と、続く戦乱に疲れ果てた人々にとって、何よりも必要だったのは休息であった。漢の初めに重んじられたのが、伝説の帝王黄帝と老子の名を冠した「黄老」の考えである。上に立つ者は余計なことをせず、民を休ませれば、世は自ずから治まる。

[[p:曹参]]は斉の宰相となったとき、斉の学者たちを集めて治め方を問うたが、百人百様で決められなかった。膠西に蓋公という黄老の学者がいると聞いて招くと、蓋公は「治める道は清らかで静かであることを貴ぶ。そうすれば民は自ずから落ち着く」と答えた。曹参はそれに従い、九年で斉はよく治まった。

漢は税を軽くし、労役を減らし、「民と共に休息する」政治を数十年続けた。文帝・景帝の時代、蔵の銭は数えきれず、銭を通す紐が腐るほどだったと『史記』は書く。
body.en:
Worn out by Qin's harsh laws and the wars that followed, what people needed above all was rest. Early Han honoured the "Huang-Lao" teaching, named for the legendary Yellow Emperor and Laozi: let those above do nothing needless, let the people rest, and the world governs itself.

When Cao Can became chief minister of Qi he asked the scholars of Qi how to govern, and got a hundred answers. Hearing of a Huang-Lao master, Lord Gai of Jiaoxi, he sent for him; the old man said: "The way of governing prizes clarity and stillness; then the people settle of themselves." Cao Can followed it, and in nine years Qi was well ruled.

Han kept taxes light and labour service small, "resting together with the people", for decades. Under Emperors Wen and Jing, says the Records of the Grand Historian, there was so much money in the treasury that the cords stringing the coins rotted.

body.ja:
前213年、始皇帝の宴の席で、博士の淳于越は「古の殷周は子弟を王に封じて千年余り続いた。古を師としないで長く続いた例はない」と、郡県をやめて封建に戻すよう説いた。丞相の[[p:李斯]]は猛然と反論した。「学者たちは今を学ばず古を学び、それで今を誹り、民を惑わしている」。

始皇帝は李斯の進言を入れ、秦の記録以外の歴史書と、民間の『詩』『書』や諸子の書を焼かせた。残されたのは医薬・占い・農業の書だけ。『詩』『書』を語り合う者は死罪、古を引いて今を誹る者は一族皆殺しとした。翌年には、始皇帝を誹ったとして四百六十余人の学者や方士を咸陽で穴に埋めたと『史記』は伝える。

書を守った者もいた。秦の博士伏生は『書経』を壁の中に塗り込めて隠し、漢の世になって掘り出した。孔子の旧宅の壁からも、漢の時代に古い文字で書かれた経書が見つかっている。秦の博士だった[[p:叔孫通]]は、秦の終わりに逃れて、のちに漢の朝廷の儀礼を作った。
body.en:
At a banquet of the First Emperor in 213 BC the scholar Chunyu Yue argued that Shang and Zhou had lasted a thousand years by giving fiefs to their kin, and that nothing lasted that did not take antiquity as its teacher: the commanderies should give way to fiefs. The chancellor [[p:李斯|Li Si]] answered fiercely: the scholars learned not the present but the past, and used it to slander the present and confuse the people.

The emperor took Li Si's advice. Every history but Qin's, and the Odes, the Documents and the books of the philosophers in private hands, were burned; only books of medicine, divination and farming were spared. To discuss the Odes and Documents was death; to use the past to criticise the present, death for the whole clan. The next year, says the Records of the Grand Historian, more than four hundred and sixty scholars and magicians accused of slandering the emperor were buried at Xianyang.

Some saved the books. Fu Sheng, a Qin scholar, walled up the Documents and dug them out again under Han; old texts in ancient script were found in the walls of Confucius's house in Han times too. [[p:叔孫通|Shusun Tong]], a scholar at the Qin court, slipped away at its end and later drew up the ceremonies of the Han court.
